_comment: The PyPI artifact this wrapper installs, pinned by digest.
PyPI is the single source of truth: this package carries no copy of the plugin,
only the coordinates of one and the hash it must have. That is deliberate — a
second complete copy in a second registry is how eight vendored guard versions
ended up spanning 1.0.2 to 2.1.0. Fetch-and-verify makes drift impossible rather
than a discipline someone has to keep.
`sha256` is the anchor. It is fixed when this npm package is published, so it does
not matter whether the registry that serves the wheel later reports something
different — a mismatch is a hard failure, not a warning.
